answer.reason: The verses tell of the tablets being given, broken, remade and placed in the ark, which gives a few defining events.

clauses.english: was given to Moses on Sinai, written with the finger of God
clauses.quote: two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God

clauses.english: was broken by Moses beneath the mount when he saw the golden calf
clauses.quote: he cast the tables out of his hands, and brake them beneath the mount

clauses.english: was hewn again by Moses and written anew by the LORD with the ten commandments
clauses.quote: Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first

clauses.english: was placed by Moses in the ark he had made
clauses.quote: put the tables in the ark which I had made

doubts: The calf is not named in DEU 9:16; EXO 32:19 names it.
Four clauses is at the upper limit; the giving, breaking, renewing and placing in the ark are each a major event.
